title: Basic password authentication
description: Users can sign up and log in with email and password. Includes password hashing with bcrypt and session management via JWT tokens.

title: Email notification service
description: Send transactional emails for password reset, welcome emails, and team invitations using shared SMTP relay.

title: API rate limiting - global 100 req/s
description: Implement global rate limiting at 100 requests per second across all API endpoints using in-memory counter.

title: CSV data export
description: Allow users to export their project data as CSV files. Synchronous implementation handles up to 5000 rows.

title: User settings page
description: Settings page for profile, notification preferences, and account management. Desktop-only layout.

title: Main dashboard with project overview
description: Dashboard showing all user projects with key metrics. Uses sequential database queries for each widget.

title: Team member invitation flow
description: Project owners can invite team members via email. Invited users receive a link to join the project.

title: Unit test suite for auth module
description: Comprehensive unit tests for authentication module covering login, signup, token refresh, and password validation.

title: Investigate SSO options for enterprise
description: Research spike: evaluate SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect as SSO options for enterprise customers. Document trade-offs.

title: Redis caching layer for frequently accessed data
description: Add Redis as a caching layer for user sessions and frequently accessed project metadata to reduce database load.
